intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer a {{course}} in {{cityA}}, but they are different kinds of campus. We compare the recorded fees and placements we hold, and we flag the gaps, using official sites opened in {{year}}.

KLNCE Madurai vs The American College is an engineering-college MBA against an arts-and-science college MBA. We have a year tuition and a 2020 placement row for KLNCE, and no fee or placement row for The American College.

sections.heading: KLNCE Madurai vs The American College for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose KLNCE if you want an MBA in finance, marketing or human resources at an engineering college, with a recorded year tuition of ₹17,500 and a 2020 average and highest package of ₹3 lakh.

Choose The American College if you want an MBA on a long-running arts and science campus in Madurai, and you will get the official fee and placement letter yourself, because those rows are missing here.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what is missing
paragraphs: For KLNCE we hold ₹17,500 as MBA tuition for one year, listed separately for finance, marketing and human resources. That is a year figure, not a confirmed two-year official total, and we have not multiplied it.
The American College has no MBA fee row in our table. Do not treat the blank cell as a cheaper course. Use the official notice on americancollege.edu.in.
₹17,500 a year is above this page's ₹10,000 fee floor, so we can quote it, but you should still match it against the current Anna University or college fee circular.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Our only KLNCE MBA placement row is from 2020, with both the average and the highest recorded at ₹3 lakh for MBA Finance. That is a historical figure, not a 2025 or 2026 promise.
The American College has no MBA placement row here. Ask both placement cells for the latest report rather than reading one old KLNCE figure as the full story.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: KLNCE is listed with MAT on this page. The American College has no exam mapped, so follow its official MBA admissions note for tests, counselling or merit rules.
A Tamil Nadu engineering-college MBA and an arts-college MBA can have different counselling routes. Confirm the current process, including TANCET if it applies, on the official pages.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Madurai, so travel across the city is the main location question, not a change of town.
KLNCE is an engineering campus that also lists MBA specialisations. The American College is a historic arts and science campus. The peer group and classroom setting will differ.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick KLNCE if the recorded ₹17,500 year tuition and the MAT route are clear, and you accept that the only placement row we hold is a 2020 figure of ₹3 lakh.
Pick The American College if the campus and MBA department fit you better, after you have the official fee and a recent placement note.
Do not pick The American College only because our fee cell is empty. That gap is a missing record, not a lower price.

faqs.question: What is the MBA fee at The American College, Madurai?

faqs.question: Which exams do these MBA programmes accept?
faqs.answer: KLNCE is listed with MAT. The American College has no exam mapped on this page. Confirm the current process, including any state counselling, on the official sites.

faqs.answer: Yes. KLNCE and The American College are both recorded in Madurai, Tamil Nadu.
